article.story: CINCINNATI -- — Michael Nwoko's 19 points and 10 rebounds helped Xavier defeat Cleveland State 75-67 on Tuesday. Tru Washington scored 12 points and added three steals for the Musketeers (5-0). Ruben Dominguez shot 3 for 9, including 3 for 8 from beyond the arc to finish with nine points. Jordan Lowery led the way for the Vikings (3-3) with 22 points, four assists and two steals. Rayvon Griffith added 12 points for Cleveland State. Alex Bruskotter finished with 10 points. Xavier opened the game on a 16-3 run. Led by 15 first-half points from Nwoko, Xavier carried a 40-32 lead into the break. Dominguez's 3-pointer with 6:39 left in the second half gave Xavier the lead for good at 59-58. Up next Xavier plays Iowa at home on Friday, and Cleveland State hosts Kent State on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
